entities.summary: Samuel Stebbins Bowles, is an American economist and professor emeritus at the University of Massachusetts Amherst, where he continues to teach courses on microeconomics and the theory of institutions. His work is associated with the neo-Marxian tradition of economic thought. However, his perspective on economics is eclectic and draws on various schools of thought, including what he and others refer to as post-Walrasian economics. Samuel Bowles was a writers & intellectuals from New Haven (b. 1939, New Haven). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
